p5_b0.ocr: In the Q1 2024 report for EY's Professional & Business Services, key metrics are presented across two tables, starting with the Consultant Metrics table, which includes headers such as Revenue per Consultant, Utilization Rate, Billable Hours, Financial Ratios, Gross Margin, Net Profit Margin, P/E Ratio, Current Ratio, Debt/Equity Ratio, and Retention Rate. For Q1 2024, the Revenue per Consultant is $150K, with a Utilization Rate of 75% and Billable Hours totaling 1200, alongside a Gross Margin of 60%, a Net Profit Margin of 25%, a P/E Ratio of 15, a Current Ratio of 1.5, a Debt/Equity Ratio of 0.8, and a Retention Rate of 85%.

p5_b1.ocr: In Q2 2023, the Revenue per Consultant was $140K, the Utilization Rate was 73%, with Billable Hours of 1150, a Gross Margin of 58%, a Net Profit Margin of 24%, a P/E Ratio of 14, a Current Ratio of 1.6, a Debt/Equity Ratio of 0.9, and a Retention Rate of 87%. For Q1 2023, these metrics were $130K, 70%, 1100, 57%, 23%, 13, 1.5, 0.8, and 83%, respectively.
